thesis: The speaker recounts two formative college experiences that introduced him to the dangers of survivorship bias and the tendency of the industry to curve-fit history. He explains how his first project revealed that back-tests on surviving instruments ignored bankrupt stocks, leading him to realize the entire industry was plagued by cherry-picked versions of history rather than actual history.
